erin (product): Quick thread: scoping a long-term platform initiative — routing rules + multi-region routing + tenant isolation. Need a crisp pilot plan + gating criteria. Goal: pilot in ~3 months.

kai (eng-platform): +1. Key ask: define 2-3 customer-facing lanes (latency, balanced, economical) with clear fallback semantics and cost deltas. We need a simple pricing sketch early.

dara (arch): Recommend a tiny, verifiable routing manifest (v0). Fields: selector, allowed_regions, lane, fallback_policy, locked. Enforceable and audited. Example: route "org/foo/api" -> regions [us-west-2], lane "balanced", fallback {region: us-east-1, model: q4}.

pete (infra): Ops caveat: cross-region fallback = cold KV cache + egress. We should simulate warmup cost and cold-hit latency for a handful of prefixes. Also need a plan for pre-warm for customers that opt in.

mira (solutions): From field: enterprises want route-level region pin and signed audit logs for compliance; smaller customers want a low-cost lane even if p99 is worse. Regulated customers require a migration checklist.

erin (product): Draft pilot gates: (1) two pilot customers using pinned routes or dedicated lanes; (2) lane SLOs defined + measured; (3) migration + rollback runbook; (4) simple policy UI + exportable audit log; (5) opt-out for automatic fallback per tenant.

kai (eng-platform): Also need feature flags and dry-run mode for manifests. Live policy changes must be atomic with a safe rollback.

dara (arch): We'll include a versioned manifest and precedence rules (exact selector > prefix > global). Policy engine will emit decision reasons.

pete (infra): I'll run 3 sims (spike/steady/burst) and return a warmup/egress heatmap in 10 business days.

mira (solutions): I'll gather 3 customer requirement docs and map them to the gates (1 week).

erin (product): Action items: dara+kai policy v0 (EOW); pete sims (10d); mira customer mapping (1w); sales to recruit pilots (ASAP). I'll draft a milestone roadmap + gating table and post to #product-docs by Friday.

announce-bot: deploy queued: infra/experiments/routing-manifest-proto by dara at 2024-10-05T14:00:00Z

erin (product): Thanks — flag blockers here or DM me. :thumbsup:
